ロックマンの空下は、強い3コマではメテオにならない――Timing the Hard Knuckle

Mega Man's down air is a timing puzzle. The stronger early hit does not meteor, the weaker late hit does, grounded targets launch differently, and reflection flips the result. 日本語で基礎を確かめながら、startup, landing lag, lowest reliable release, edgeguarding, training drillsをつなげて理解する。
